sentences.en: On my way upstairs I thought of the famous pianist.
sentences.zh: 在我上楼的路上想起了那位著名的钢琴家。

sentences.en: It took a lot of effort to carry the sofa upstairs.
sentences.zh: 搬沙发到楼上花了很大的力气。

sentences.en: It looks like Janet's going to be kicked upstairs.
sentences.zh: 看来珍妮特要被晋升了。

senses.zh: 在楼上，往楼上，高水平地，上层地，头脑上地
